2. STATE AGENCIES
The State Clearinghouse, Office of Planning and Analysis, transmits and receives comments from the following:
*Director, Department of Conservation Director, Department of Correction *Director, Environmental Protection Agency Director, Governor's Office of Manpower Development *Director, Department of Business and Economic Development Director, Department of Aeronautics Director, Department of Local Government Affairs *Director, Department of Mines and Minerals Director, Governor's Office of Human Resources *Director, Department of Agriculture Director, Board of Vocational Rehabilitation Director, Office of Comprehensive Health Planning Director, Department of Children and Family Services *Director, Department of Public Health *Chief Waterways Engineer Director, Department of Registration and Education Chief, Illinois State Geological Survey Chief, Illinois State Natural History Survey Director, Illinois State Archaeological Survey Illinois State Library (Information only)
(*) 
The Natural Resource Development Board of the State of Illinois consists of these, so marked (*), agencies. Reply from these agencies is included in the reply from the Department of Business and Economic Development.
